Course.title: 30 Days No Code Simulation
Course.subtitle: 30 Days. One Real Product. Zero Coding Required.
Course.description: An application-based simulation to help selected participants build and ship a real-world, production-ready no-code product in 30 days.
benefits: Build by doing with one continuous product idea
Use no-code tools and AI integrations for real functionality
Create a project you can present, test and keep improving
whatYouLearn: Define a real product problem and shape a no-code solution
Build a core application interface and essential features
Integrate AI capabilities and third-party services
Test your product and prepare a working demonstration
targetAudience: Candidates who meet ROAC's published eligibility criteria
Applicants shortlisted through the internal assessment

CourseSections.title: Week 1 — Idea & Foundations
CourseSections.description: Define the problem, shape your product idea and understand the no-code tools.

CourseSections.title: Week 2 — Build the Application
CourseSections.description: Create the core interface, structure and essential functionality.

CourseSections.title: Week 3 — AI & Integrations
CourseSections.description: Add relevant AI features, connect services and automate workflows.

CourseSections.title: Week 4 — Test & Prepare to Ship
CourseSections.description: Test your product, fix issues and prepare a working demonstration.

admissions.publicNotice: Only 30 candidates will be selected via assessment. No program fee for selected candidates.
admissions.guidance: Course.isFree does not itself enforce the eligibility assessment. Do not auto-enroll all applicants; create CourseEnrollment only after accepted, according to your existing authorization flow.
